title: Phone Number Config Notification
description: Configuration settings for configuring a Phone Number for the Voice Notification Application.

phoneNumber.description: The Phone Number that the current configuration applies to.

appAccountGuid.description: The unique identifier of the application can be found in the Voice Management App in the API Settings section.

type.description: The Application type that should be used. Can be either `directforwarding`, `flowbuilder`, `notification`, `sip`, `halo` or `none`.

promptType.description: The type of prompt that should be played in the notification. Can be either `file` for a custom audio file in the Voice Audio Manager, or `tts` for a text-to-speech message.

prompt.description: The text-to-speech message if the PromptType property is set to `tts`, or the path of the audio file in the Voice Audio Manager if the PromptType property is set to `file`.

language.description: The language of the text-to-speech voice that will be used in ISO 639-1 format. Only relevant if the PromptType value is set to `tts`.

gender.description: The gender of the text-to-speech voice that will be used. Can be either `male` or `female`. Only relevant if the PromptType value is set to `tts`.

voiceNumber.description: The specific text-to-speech voice that will be used for the given Language and Gender combination. Only relevant if the PromptType value is set to `tts`. Should in most cases be set to 1.

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL that will be called after the Notification was completed.
